headline: Na Hong-Jin Reveals Roots of Hope
post:
Director Na Hong-Jin recently shared some fascinating background details about his upcoming movie "Hope" during a masterclass at the Busan International Film Festival. He explained to the audience that the project stemmed from his belief back in 2017 that a war might break out on the Korean peninsula, noting how intense news reports were at that time.

It is always so interesting to learn what inspires filmmakers to bring their visions to the big screen. 🎬

What is your favorite film by this director?

headline: Dr. Erica Schwartz and CDC Hepatitis B study funding
post:
Hey friends. According to Rolling Stone, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has reportedly moved to allocate new funds for a controversial clinical trial in Guinea-Bissau. A staff member within the director's office allegedly instructed the budget office to set aside $1.6 million for the research. 🩺

The study aims to examine whether the birth dose of the hepatitis B vaccine has potential negative health effects. Critics, including pediatricians and infectious disease experts, have expressed strong ethical concerns about the project design. Meanwhile, the University of Southern Denmark recently gave the researchers approval to proceed following an ethical assessment.

What are your thoughts on this unfolding situation? 🌍

#CDC #HealthNews #VaccineStudy
original_title: CDC Is Moving Forward With a Previously Shelved Controversial Hepatitis B Vaccine Study

headline: Texas Executes Jamaal Howard After Legal Challenge
post:
Texas carried out the execution of Jamaal Howard on Wednesday night following a legal challenge involving the drug pentobarbital. Howard's attorneys had asked courts to halt the process, pointing to concerns over the same drug reportedly used during Christa Pike's botched execution in Tennessee last week.

Before the procedure, Howard addressed the family of convenience store clerk Vickie Swartout, stating he wished for their forgiveness. Witnesses reported that Howard gasped and coughed as the pentobarbital took effect before he was pronounced dead.

Further updates will follow as more information becomes available.

#Entertainment #Hollywood #PopCulture
original_title: Texas Executes Inmate After Christa Pike Survives Botched Lethal Injection

headline: Andrew Scott shines at London Film Festival
post:
Andrew Scott grew visibly emotional on stage during the opening of the 2026 BFI London Film Festival. According to The Hollywood Reporter, the star welcomed real-life people who inspired characters in the film, including a pioneer of HIV/AIDS treatment and a longtime theater staff member. 🎬

The feature tells the story of Ian Charleson’s final weeks playing Hamlet before his death from AIDS in the 1990s. Cast member Joe Locke shared that he wept while reading the script on a flight home for the holidays.

Director Simon Stone praised the lead actor's rare ability to move effortlessly between stage and film modes. Have you ever cried while reading a script or book on a plane? 

#LondonFilmFestival #AndrewScott #ElsinoreFilm
original_title: An Emotional Andrew Scott and ‘Elsinore’ Kick Off a Starry 2026 London Film Festival
